newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Baxter to launch Immuno offer soon.
newsitem.headline: Baxter to launch Immuno offer soon.

text.p: Baxter International Inc said it intended to launch its previously announced public offer for bearer shares of Immuno International AG in the second half of November if U.S. regulators approve its acquisition of Immuno.

Baxter will offer 900 Swiss francs per share for the 273,220 outstanding shares held by the public in the Swiss-based maker of blood products and vaccines. Immuno shares were quoted at 892 francs, unchanged from yesterday's close.
"Baxter intends to make this public offer in the second half of November and to complete it by the end of the year," it said in a statement released in Switzerland.
The U.S. Federal Trade Commission is still studying the deal, which was announced in August and approved by the European Commission in October.
At the same time, Immuno unit Immuno Finance Ltd will launch an offer for its 75 million Swiss franc issue of 3-1/2 percent convertible bonds due 1998.
The price offered will probably be 102 percent of par plus interest accrued, according to the statement.
